note: Reggio Calabria with Villa San Giovanni, the Gioia Tauro plain, Palmi and the Ionian Locride; Reggio airport (REG). note: Messina with the Tyrrhenian coast of the Peloritani and Nebrodi from Caronia through Sant'Agata di Militello, Capo d'Orlando and Patti to Milazzo, on the A20 motorway and coastal railway. No airport: Reggio Calabria or Catania. The Nebrodi crest bounds it south; the Aeolian Islands, reached only by ferry, are left out.
